LESSON: MINING IN KENYA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities
Topic 3.2: Mining in Kenya

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Mining in Kenya
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we benefit from the minerals found in our country?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify major minerals found in Kenya
2. use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify major minerals found in Kenya

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify major minerals found in Kenya.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify major minerals found in Kenya” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify major minerals found in Kenya” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify major minerals found in Kenya" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals

Teach
• Today’s focus: use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals” using a school example.
• Model B for “use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify major minerals found in Kenya
• Model 2: use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify major minerals found in Kenya
2. Practise: use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Mining in Kenya.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we benefit from the minerals found in our country?
2. How does the government promote mining in Kenya?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify major minerals found in Kenya
• use the map of Kenya to locate major minerals

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
